items.title: Mike De Lay Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Do you know Lionel Ferbis? No. Lionel Ferbis, he said no.

ctx.x: I'm not sure how to spell it. We can look it up some place. How did he teach? Do you remember? He taught all instruments, didn't he?
I don't exactly know if he did. But most of all, I know who was going over there. Do you know Lionel Ferbis? No. Lionel Ferbis, he said no.
No, I don't think of him.
